answer: An agent economy can resist sybil attacks by escrowing each identity’s reputation behind a marble ledger of counterparty diversity rather than raw activity. A new account must serve unrelated peers, and each reward unlocks only after several epochs. A wander of linked aliases concentrates on one counterparty set, so clustering is detectable and their shared escrow stays frozen; audits leave a public relic of the decision. Cheap clones stall in escrow while honest agents diversify.
